# 菩薩善戒經

**ID:** T1583
**Volume:** T30
**Category:** 瑜伽部類
**Original Category:** 瑜伽部
**Byline:** 劉宋 求那跋摩譯
**Dynasty:** 劉宋
**Date:** 431
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T1583

## Contributors
- 求那跋摩 (A000218)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A short, single-fascicle text traditionally counted as a separate work but in fact an extract from the larger nine-fascicle *Púsà shànjiè jīng* ([KR6n0004](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0004), T30n1582) of the same translator, [求那跋摩](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B1%82%E9%82%A3%E8%B7%8B%E6%91%A9) (Guṇavarman, 367–431). The single fascicle preserves the *Púsàjiè běn* 菩薩戒本 — the bodhisattva-precept core — extracted from the larger translation for liturgical use in the Liú-Sòng monastic communities. It thus stands in the same relation to T1582 as Dharmakṣema's *Púsà jièběn* 菩薩戒本 ([KR6k0020](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0020), T30n1500) stands to the *Púsà dìchí jīng* ([KR6n0003](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0003), T30n1581).

**Abstract**

[求那跋摩](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B1%82%E9%82%A3%E8%B7%8B%E6%91%A9) arrived in Jiànkāng 建康 in 431 CE (Yuánjiā 元嘉 8) and died there later the same year. The *Chū sānzàng jì jí* 出三藏記集 (T2145) reports both T1582 and T1583 as products of his Jǐyuánsì 祇洹寺 translation work in that single year. Tradition treats T1583 as the *jièběn* (precept-text) extracted for chanting at the bodhisattva-precept ceremony; the parallel later passage in T1582 is generally considered the textual source.

The text was widely used in the early Northern and Southern dynasties for the conferral of the bodhisattva-precepts and is repeatedly cited in early *Púsàjiè* commentaries. Its short length and standalone format made it the standard short *jièběn* for the Liú-Sòng and early Liáng monasteries; it was eventually superseded in normative status by the *Fànwǎng jīng* 梵網經 ([KR6k0017](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0017)) but never entirely replaced in the Northern transmission.
